title: Free Guide: Mesh MEA Organoid Culture Protocols
body_markdown:
## Successful experiments start with a successful culture.


If you're doing organoid electrophysiology work with[Mesh MEA™](https://www.harvardbioscience.com/node/299) , successfully culturing and seeding your organoids is crucial for maximizing the technology's potential. Our free guide compiles a range of experimental protocols to help guide researchers through the processes of culturing and seeding different types of organoids.


By following these methods, which have been provided by actual Mesh MEA users, researchers can overcome experimental challenges and ensure reliable and reproducible data acquisition.


### What's inside:


- Conditioning protocols
- Brian organoid protocols
- Cardiac organoid protocols
- Retinal organoid protocols
